user.title: Connect auroMATIC via ebusd
user.description: Address of the ebusd service, not of the eBUS adapter. When ebusd runs as an add-on, use the hostname shown in the add-on terminal prompt, e.g. "2ad9b828-ebusd". A suggestion is pre-filled if one was found.

error.cannot_connect: ebusd does not answer. Is the service running, and is the port correct?

abort.already_configured: This ebusd is already set up.

init.title: Polling interval
init.description: How often the ebusd cache is read. Causes no additional bus traffic.
